title: Minimal Read Command with short object path
purpose: Create a distinct mutation-friendly read-command style I-frame using conservative short-object encoding so a fuzzer can vary COT, CA, and IOA fields around a valid-looking baseline while staying separate from previously duplicated VSQ-mismatch analogues.
expected_behavior: The implementation should parse the short read-command style ASDU, reject unsupported semantics if necessary, and avoid null dereference or out-of-bounds access in downstream object handling.
constraints_preserved: widely recognized IEC 60870-5-104 style APCI/I-frame form
visible length octet matches frame size
distinct payload from prior library entries
issue_safety_notes: Uses a conservative read-command analogue rather than any exact report payload. It is intended for mutation around object address and cause fields, not direct crash reproduction.
